paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 3.3, representing a decrease of 2.8% from the prior close and 30.82% over the last 23 sessions. There have been 6 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi America amending the terms of an equipment supply loan from MUFG Bank, Cantor Fitzgerald reducing their price target on shares of Fermi from $12.00 to $8.00, and the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission supporting a license for four AP1000 reactors at Fermi America's Project Matador. Additionally, there have been reports of major shareholders selling shares of the stock, including Toby Neugebauer selling 1,297,200 shares and 2,750,000 shares in separate transactions.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 filings and 2 Form 144 filings. Recent filings include an 8-K form announcing a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, and a Form 4 filing reporting an insider transaction. There have also been notices of proposed sales filed by insiders, declaring their intent to sell restricted shares.
